You'll build and nurture an engaged community, stay on top of social media trends, and adapt them creatively for community management. With a salary of 800 EUR/Month GROSS, you'll enjoy epic team-buildings, annual workation, and an investment in your growth, including a 650 EUR learning & development budget.
